title: Unrestricted completeness is invariant under derived isomorphism
statement: For every prime l, finite-dimensional extension E of Q_l, independently sized scheme X, derived objects K and M in integralTowerModules l E X, and isomorphism e : K ≅ M, IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E X K implies IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E X M. The existing predicate is the augmented reduction-tower Roos triangle condition; the finite-field witness is retained.

proof.text: The resulting Roos triangle is isomorphic to the original one, with e.symm on the first object and identities on both products. Check the first square on every product projection using inverse cancellation; the remaining squares are identity and shifted inverse cancellation. Apply Pretriangulated.isomorphic_distinguished.
